
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/halfcode/p/23462276" title="发布于 2026-10-28 10:44">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">13. 布尔类型 boolean | 判断成绩是否及格</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>ArkTS 里，<code>boolean</code> 只有两个值：<code>true</code> 和 <code>false</code>。二选一的状态、判断出来的结果，都放在这里。</p>
<p>动画视频在<a href="https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1mPxg66Ek5/" rel="noopener nofollow">《13. 布尔类型 boolean | 判断成绩是否及格》</a>。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 条件成立，及格</span>
let isPass: <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">boolean</span> = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 条件不成立，不加糖</span>
let addSugar: <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">boolean</span> = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span>;</pre>
</div>
<p>布尔值一般有两个来源。可以直接写 <code>true</code> 或 <code>false</code>，也可以写比较表达式，比较算完就是布尔结果。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 直接赋值</span>
let res1: <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">boolean</span> = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 比较运算</span>
let res2: <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">boolean</span> = 80 &gt;= 60;</pre>
</div>
<p><code>80 &gt;= 60</code> 成立，<code>res2</code> 是 <code>true</code>。</p>
<h2>成绩过不过 60</h2>
<p>数学成绩沿用上一课的 86.5。及格线按 60 算，用 <code>&gt;=</code> 比一次，结果放进 <code>isPass</code>。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 期末成绩</span>
let mathScore: number = 86.5<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 判断成绩是否及格</span>
let isPass: <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">boolean</span> = mathScore &gt;= 60;</pre>
</div>
<p>86.5 比 60 大，比较成立，<code>isPass</code> 是 <code>true</code>。</p>
<p>奶茶这杯不加糖。这里没有比较，直接赋 <code>false</code>。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 是否加糖</span>
let addSugar: <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">boolean</span> = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span>;</pre>
</div>
<h2><img alt="不加糖" loading="lazy" style="font-size: 14px" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1919157/202610/1919157-20261028061330179-1897524394.jpg" class="lazyload"></h2>
<h2>&nbsp;打印这两个结果</h2>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">------------------------------
布尔类型：boolean
-------------------------------</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span>

<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 期末成绩</span>
let mathScore: number = 86.5<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 判断成绩是否及格</span>
let isPass: <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">boolean</span> = mathScore &gt;= 60<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 是否加糖</span>
let addSugar: <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">boolean</span> = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 打印信息</span>
console.log("是否及格 = "<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, isPass);
console.log(</span>"是否加糖 = ", addSugar);</pre>
</div>
<p>日志两行：<code>是否及格 = true</code>，<code>是否加糖 = false</code>。</p>
<p>先开启预览器，再打开日志面板，按 Ctrl + S 保存，才能看到这两行。预览器没开，日志里不会有输出。</p>
<h2>成绩改成 59</h2>
<p>把 <code>mathScore</code> 改成 59，再跑一次。<code>isPass</code> 那一行不用动，它还是拿 <code>mathScore</code> 去和 60 比。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>let mathScore: number = 59<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
let isPass: </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">boolean</span> = mathScore &gt;= 60;</pre>
</div>
<p>59 没有到 60，比较不成立，<code>isPass</code> 变成 <code>false</code>。加糖那一行没改，日志里仍是 <code>false</code>。</p>
<p><img alt="及格与不及格" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1919157/202610/1919157-20261028061344971-1918908520.jpg" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>

</div>
